# Interaction learning: How are credit and teacher information assigned after standardizing trajectories?

[简体中文](../../../../learning/deep-dives/agent-research/agent-policy-learning.md) · English

Updated 2026-11-13 · 54 topic entries / 7 representative comparisons

Agent Lightning turns execution into trainable transitions. GiGPO, AdaStep, and DepGPO assign credit using repeated states, return variance, and command dependencies, respectively. Frontier-OPD and ASTEROID change how teacher data reaches students. Recording a trajectory is only the entry point; objectives and information access define the algorithms.

[Mechanisms](#comparison) · [Trade-offs](#analysis) · [Cross-paper questions](#questions) · [Updates](#updates)

!!! note "How to read this card"

    The table compares representative methods. It is not a shared-benchmark leaderboard. Teaching examples are not measured results.

## Trade-off analysis {#analysis}

### Local credit is trustworthy only when its evidence is trustworthy

GiGPO complements global advantage with return comparisons within a shared anchor. AdaStep asks how much variation is explained by actions versus random continuation. DepGPO instead uses actual file, stdout, and verifier dependencies, without requiring recurrent states. These are not interchangeable step rewards. Fine-grained numbers do not add evidence without trustworthy states or traces. Agent Lightning's common transitions help connect algorithms but do not supply missing conditions.

Sources: [GiGPO](../../../../agent-research/2505.10978-gigpo/README-en.md) · [AdaStep: Adaptive Step Credit Weighting for Agentic Reinforcement Learning](../../../../agent-research/2610.03223-adastep/README-en.md) · [Credit Where It Matters: Dependency-Aware Policy Optimization for Terminal Agents](../../../../agent-research/2610.03634-depgpo/README-en.md) · [Agent Lightning](../../../../agent-research/2508.03680-agent-lightning/README-en.md)

### Teachers change training data, not what deployment can see

Frontier-OPD selects short intervention from student-visited states. Compare a window matching actual bridge length plus continuation, and add only teacher bridge responses. ASTEROID conditions on exploration history and then supplies a full success for the same hidden task, covering contexts outside smooth expert openings. Teacher units and objectives differ. Deployment sees only public observations and its own history, not hidden tasks, gold, or future outcomes inserted for convenient replay.

Sources: [Frontier-OPD: Discovering the Edge of Agent Capability and Teaching Agents to Go Beyond](../../../../agent-research/2610.32802-frontier-opd/README-en.md) · [Asymmetric On-Policy Distillation Learns In-Context Exploration](../../../../agent-research/2610.30105-asteroid/README-en.md)

### When trajectories become training data, objective boundaries matter more than shared interfaces

Agent Lightning turns heterogeneous execution into attributable transitions. Instruct-to-Act binds language to non-overlapping intervals within one episode and marks instruction completion at the end. Unannotated valid steps have no BC but remain stop negatives; padding affects neither. RSSM, actor/value training and real rollouts remain necessary.

Sources: [Decoupling Planning and Control for Instructable Agents](../../../../agent-research/2608.26788-instruct-to-act/README-en.md) · [Agent Lightning](../../../../agent-research/2508.03680-agent-lightning/README-en.md)

## Cross-paper questions {#questions}

Try answering before expanding the explanation. Each question relates at least two papers.

### When outcomes vary widely after the same action, why do GiGPO, AdaStep, and DepGPO need different evidence? {#cross-local-credit-evidence}

??? note "Show answer and example"

    **Answer:** GiGPO compares local returns across actions at one anchor. AdaStep uses within-action and total variance to assess reliability and reduces correction under high continuation randomness. DepGPO checks whether command outputs reach the verifier by dependencies rather than using within-action variance. Choose evidence according to reliable recurrent states or tracing; synthetic anchors cannot establish a fair real-state comparison.

    **Illustrative example:** Incorrect answers after identical searches may reflect later writing variation. A terminal task can instead check whether a write command supplied data consumed by the final test.

    Sources: [GiGPO](../../../../agent-research/2505.10978-gigpo/README-en.md) · [AdaStep: Adaptive Step Credit Weighting for Agentic Reinforcement Learning](../../../../agent-research/2610.03223-adastep/README-en.md) · [Credit Where It Matters: Dependency-Aware Policy Optimization for Terminal Agents](../../../../agent-research/2610.03634-depgpo/README-en.md)

### Why can't Frontier-OPD teacher bridges and ASTEROID expert successes both be reduced to one expert label at the current state? {#cross-bridge-versus-successful-episode}

??? note "Show answer and example"

    **Answer:** Frontier-OPD uses a short bridge to change reachable continuation and admits responses by equal-length agreement over bridge plus student continuation. ASTEROID conditions on student exploration before learning from a complete same-task expert episode; BAMDP preserves hidden tasks across episodes. A single label erases differences in context, collection units, and admission.

    **Illustrative example:** Briefly helping a student past a blockage and returning control is not the same training example as a whole expert success after two student trials.

    Sources: [Frontier-OPD: Discovering the Edge of Agent Capability and Teaching Agents to Go Beyond](../../../../agent-research/2610.32802-frontier-opd/README-en.md) · [Asymmetric On-Policy Distillation Learns In-Context Exploration](../../../../agent-research/2610.30105-asteroid/README-en.md)

### When does connecting Agent Lightning transitions to GiGPO or Frontier-OPD count as training integration? {#cross-transition-log-versus-actual-update}

??? note "Show answer and example"

    **Answer:** Records must contain required state, sampling policy, and permitted supervision. The trainer must update parameters with the appropriate advantage or distillation objective and evaluate. GiGPO needs valid anchor groups; Frontier-OPD needs original histories, valid bridges, and training-pool isolation. Names, counts, and callbacks are insufficient. Local controlled patch updates and L1 contracts are not LLM policy training.

    **Illustrative example:** A thousand actions without shared-state identity or frozen teacher/student probabilities cannot compute micro advantages or validate teacher bridge admission.

    Sources: [Agent Lightning](../../../../agent-research/2508.03680-agent-lightning/README-en.md) · [GiGPO](../../../../agent-research/2505.10978-gigpo/README-en.md) · [Frontier-OPD: Discovering the Edge of Agent Capability and Teaching Agents to Go Beyond](../../../../agent-research/2610.32802-frontier-opd/README-en.md)

### Do correct BC and stop losses reproduce the language world-model controller? {#cross-cross-colm-instruct-to-act}

??? note "Show answer and example"

    **Answer:** No. RSSM model/actor/value learning, real rollouts, instruction embeddings and annotation are still required. Local code executes two auxiliary objectives without replacing missing networks.

    **Illustrative example:** Teaching example: correct gradients do not establish diamond collection in Minecraft.

    Sources: [Decoupling Planning and Control for Instructable Agents](../../../../agent-research/2608.26788-instruct-to-act/README-en.md) · [Agent Lightning](../../../../agent-research/2508.03680-agent-lightning/README-en.md)

## Update log {#updates}

Updates record new approaches, changed trade-offs, and follow-up evidence.

**2026-11-13** · Repair the historical instruct-to-act omission. Label own-rollout intervals post hoc, train BC on annotated actions and stop on completion endpoints, retaining other Dreamer objectives. Agent Lightning separates execution from RL transitions; Instruct-to-Act separates planning from high-frequency control. These are different interfaces, and labels do not replace missing RSSM/environment learning.

Affected: [Decoupling Planning and Control for Instructable Agents](../../../../agent-research/2608.26788-instruct-to-act/README-en.md) · [Agent Lightning](../../../../agent-research/2508.03680-agent-lightning/README-en.md)

**2026-10-27** · Initial version: compared transition integration, state-group credit, variance reliability, command dependencies, and two teacher-data mechanisms, distinguishing training and deployment information.
